basic_info.description: Welcome to 813-813A York Street, a beautifully preserved and thoughtfully updated home in the heart of the buzzy, vibrant & sunny Mission District. This striking home provides a variety of options for many types of buyers. Both units are vacant and offer an opportunity for owners or investors. The lower unit was recently remodeled with permits. Each unit features updates including double-pane windows, wood flooring, refreshed landscaping, recessed lights and designer lighting. The upper unit includes 3 bedrooms & 2 bathrooms, with a primary bedroom boasting a stunning view of Twin Peaks. The lower unit comprises 2 bedrooms & 1 bathroom and has been fully modernized with recessed lighting, a new kitchen, and a contemporary bathroom. Each unit has separate laundry facilities. The spacious backyard invites with its mature orange trees, patio & garden. Grandfathered storage space extends livability. Fabulous restaurants--Flour & Water, San Ho Won, Farmhouse Thai, Base Camp, Marigold Coffee Shop and Lost Resort--are just a stone's throw away.
